assessments.referenceTitle: Brief mindfulness interventions and student wellbeing
assessments.claim: The intervention doubled wellbeing scores over twelve weeks.
assessments.note: The retrieved abstract reports a small positive association (roughly 0.2 SD), not a doubling; the manuscript overstates the source.
The abstract reports cross-sectional associations in mostly correlational work, which supports an association but not the causal increase as written.

assessments.referenceTitle: A meta-analysis of workplace strengths interventions
assessments.claim: A meta-analysis confirms the pooled effect the manuscript relies on.
assessments.note: No abstract was retrievable for this reference, so support cannot be judged and is not guessed.

findings.claim: The abstract of the cited mindfulness trial reports a small association, not the doubling the manuscript claims; the citing sentence overstates the source.
findings.failureScenario: The overclaim inflates the evidence base for a central argument and misrepresents the cited work.
findings.leanestFix: Reword the claim to match the association the source actually reports, or cite a source that supports the stronger statement.

selfCritique.strongestObjection: The does_not_support verdict rests on an abstract alone; the full text could contain a longitudinal result the abstract omits.
confidenceRaisers: The full text of the cited mindfulness trial rather than only its abstract.
